scenarios.title: Close desk at start (ignore tabletop laptop clutter)
scenarios.description: Walker faces desk ~0.9m ahead with laptop on right. Must STOP for solid desk, never trigger tabletop 'laptop' alerts or say 'Path clear.'

scenarios.title: Clear wooden hallway floor (glass wall on far left)
scenarios.description: Open aisle between classroom rows. Must stay CLEAR with zero false danger or curb alarms.

scenarios.title: Office chair protruding on right (0.4-0.6m)
scenarios.description: Close chair on right side of aisle. Must steer VEER_LEFT, never veer right into the chair or trigger false curb.

scenarios.title: Classroom chairs & desk ahead/left (1.4-2.0m)
scenarios.description: Approaching chairs along classroom aisle. Must identify chair obstacle and steer around cleanly without false curb.

scenarios.title: Close person (0.5m) blocking center aisle
scenarios.description: Person standing directly ahead at 0.5m. Must STOP and identify person rather than mislabeling as 'Low overhead obstacle'.

scenarios.title: Chair backrest & jacket on right (no false curb)
scenarios.description: Passing close chair backrest and black jacket on right. Must steer VEER_LEFT around obstacle and never fire false CURB_DROP.

scenarios.title: Two people closing in on left & right (narrow gap)
scenarios.description: People on both sides at ~1.1m leaving no safe veer side. Must STOP and announce narrow gap (never 'Path clear.').
